cases.action_sequence: Insert, duplicate, delete, and restore rows. Refresh and request more rows. Open the SQL preview and the pending review. Cancel, save, and discard.
cases.expected_results: Pending counts match the edits. Cancel keeps the edits. Save clears them. Discard restores the original row values.
cases.forbidden_effects: A read-only grid accepts a mutation.
